connectedLineIdPrivacyOnRedirectedCalls.description:
Specifies the connection type to be used.
 * `NO_PRIVACY` - Connected line identification is not blocked on redirected calls.
 * `PRIVACY_FOR_EXTERNAL_CALLS` - Connected line identification is blocked on redirected calls to external numbers.
 * `PRIVACY_FOR_ALL_CALLS` - Connected line identification is blocked on all redirected calls.
